The Company’s manufacturing facilities are generally vertically integrated operations from the initial design stage through final design and manufacturing. The Company designs, manufactures and assembles its products at facilities in approximately 40 countries around the world. Our global coverage positions us near many of our customers’ locations and allows us to assist them in consolidating their supply base and lowering their production and logistics costs. In addition, the Company generally relies on local management in every region, which we believe creates a high degree of organizational stability and operational agility, as well as a deeper understanding of local markets. The IT Service segment offers IT consulting, IT system design and development, system integration, information system operation and maintenance, data centers, and network service outsourcing solutions. The Logistics segment provides global logistics services, such as supply chain and logistics consulting and solutions. It offers cloud transformation, management, and infrastructure, as well as network and security solutions. The company also provides artificial intelligence (AI) services, such as FabriX, an automated data lake management platform; Brightics Machine Learning, an AI-based data analysis platform; Brightics Data Hub, a distributed data platform; and Brightics AI Accelerator, an AutoML suite and AI consulting solution. In addition, it offers Brity Copilot, a generative AI-based collaboration solution; Brity Automation, an AI-driven Brity robotic process automation solution; Caidentia, an AI-powered procurement and N-tier supplier relationship management solution; manufacturing execution system, an unstructured data analysis platform; share space management and workplace book; and digital health solutions comprising remote patient monitoring and interactive patient care. Further, it provides enterprise mobility solutions, including zero touch mobility; managed mobility services; EMM (On-Prem), an enterprise solution that simplifies managing and setting up employees devices;); secure settings; Data Sweeper, a solution which helps in clearing application data; and Inertia, a solution that improves productivity and safety within warehouse operations, as well as enterprise solutions and digital transformations services. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

company.name: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Ltd
company.description: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of telescopes and dome enclosures, laser satellite tracking systems, remote weapon systems, and high laser weapon. It operates through Defense Systems and Space Systems segments. The company develops, manufactures, and markets fire control, surveillance, weapon systems, and high energy laser to military customers. It also provides passive optical and laser sensing equipment; optical, microwave and on-the-move radio and satellite products; and laser-based surveillance systems with space tracking capability. In addition, the company offers counter-drone, firepower, force protection, and UGV and marine lethality systems, as well as high energy laser weapon; optical tracking systems, space control, space domain awareness, satellite laser ranging, space sustainability, and precision optics. It operates in Australia, the United States, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, New Zealand, the Netherlands, North America, Germany, and rest of Europe. Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited was founded in 1983 and is based in Symonston, Australia.
